records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Your Cedar Analytics workspace + that notification badge
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge that won't clear -- your ticket is open and Tariq is looking into it, so you'll hear back there.

Separately, nice work getting your first project set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work for that project is usually the step that makes it click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through that next step with you, or answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
